name: AmberX settings
author: Brett
description: The AmberX app's settings on the console (Settings → Plugins → AmberX): voice, the axHub watch, links and quiet, read and written in AmberX's own hub-settings@1 document on axHub so every phone follows (per-key, a phone's other keys untouched). REST /api/plugins/amberx-settings (settings, settings/{key}, reset, document with ETag for the phone's mirror); MCP amberx-settings_*; CLI axf amberx-settings …; voice "open amberx settings". Deep link console_settings("amberx"), one setting amberx-settings.focus:<key>. The watch's auto-approve switches change only from a signed-in browser, never with a token.

keeps: /projects/_shared/_data/settings/apps/amberx-droid.json on axHub: AmberX's settings document (the phones' own)

items.title: Every AmberX setting the console knows: value, default, kind, options or range
One AmberX setting (key like voice.lang, monitor.interval)
Set an AmberX setting for every phone (auto-approve ones only from a signed-in browser)
Put an AmberX setting back to its default
